formal_statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ c : ℕ, PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length ^ k) + k) true ++ false :: x) (fun n : ℕ => c * 2 ^ (n ^ k) + c)
plain_statement: For k >= 1, the map sending x to 2^(|x|^k) + k ones, a zero, then x is computable within c 2^(n^k) + c steps: the exponential clock L-lib-083 paired with the input. The padding of upward translation, for L-lib-092 and L-meta-016. Folklore. Probe: k = 0 is excluded (constant bound, linear erasure).
title: Exponential padding map: x to 1^(2^(|x|^k)+k) 0 x within O(2^(n^k)) steps, k >= 1
